predicate_verbalization.case: case(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7)

rule_verbalization.1: If case(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7) and casedet(arg8, arg9, arg10, arg11) hold and arg9 = arg1, then t(arg0, arg1, arg9, arg11) holds.

rule_verbalization.3: If cites(arg0, arg1) holds, then shouldCite(arg0, arg1) holds.
rule_verbalization.4: If shouldCite(arg0, arg1) and cites(arg1, arg2) hold, then shouldCite(arg0, arg2) holds.
rule_verbalization.5: If newcase(arg0, arg1, arg2) and case(arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7, arg8, arg9, arg10) hold and arg2 = arg8, then mayCite(arg0, arg1, arg3) holds.
rule_verbalization.6: If mayCite(arg0, arg1, arg2) and shouldCite(arg2, arg3) hold, then mayCite(arg0, arg1, arg3) holds.
rule_verbalization.Q: If mayCite(arg0, arg1, arg2) and case(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7, arg8, arg9) hold and arg9 = "convicted", then relevantCase(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3) holds.
